claims.claim: The cabinet matches the requested identity, size, fixed construction, and whitebox appearance.
claims.evidence: asset/provenance.json identifies furniture/cabinet_assembly, class furniture; asset/asset.json declares kind fixture. probes/02_geometry.out measures the mesh at 0.64399997 x 0.5 x 0.80000001 m against the requested 0.644 x 0.5 x 0.8 m. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png and iso.png show a neutral, beveled cabinet with two drawer fronts and two bars.

claims.claim: Collision boxes cover the visible cabinet and its details without blocking a required access cavity.
claims.evidence: readings.json collision_boxes and asset/model.urdf contain file_cabinet, two file_drawer boxes and two file_handle boxes. The cabinet occupies [-0.322,-0.25,0] to [0.268,0.25,0.8] m; drawer fronts extend to x=0.294 and bars to x=0.322. These correspond to the five visible parts in all four renders. probes/02_geometry.out finds all 1024 mesh vertices within the collision union at 1 micrometre tolerance. The small bevel/rounded-edge differences are consistent with box approximation. This closed, nonopening fixture has no requested accessible interior.

claims.claim: The fixture remains fixed and provides working object collision.
claims.evidence: probes/01_fixture.out: a 4 cm cube dropped above the cabinet settles after 90 frames at z=0.81994998 m, placing its bottom at z=0.79994998 against the 0.8 m top. Four contact forces total 0.980 N. The body remains at [0,0,0] with identity rotation before and after a 50 N horizontal force for 30 frames; the cube remains supported.

claims.claim: Joint travel, moving-part support, and inter-link interference checks do not apply.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no joints; readings.json joints is empty. probes/02_geometry.out confirms one URDF link and zero joints; probes/01_fixture.out reports joints {}. All five collision shapes belong to body.

claims.claim: Functional handle grasp and pull checks do not apply.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no handles; readings.json handles is empty. The two visible bars are static geometry on body, with no associated moving joint or declared grasp point.

claims.claim: Place-target placement checks do not apply.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no place targets and readings.json place_targets is empty. The supplementary cabinet-top collision test is recorded separately in probes/01_fixture.out.

claims.claim: Free rigid-object settling and upright stability checks do not apply to this fixed fixture.
claims.evidence: request.md and asset/asset.json specify kind fixture, loaded fixed on the floor. readings.json gives the cabinet base at z=0. Fixed loading was verified in probes/01_fixture.out.
